subject.title: feat(chat-ui): inline diffs for edit and write tool rows

question: Should the initial Apple diff UI complete the conservative web-parity cases now—cache-safe inputs, terminal outcomes, apply-patch, and truthful write semantics—or be explicitly narrowed to authoritative persisted edit diffs only?
rationale: Both directions are coherent, but they choose different durable user contracts for a shared iOS/macOS activity surface; the protected maintainer signal means that scope should not be inferred by an automated repair lane.

options.title: Complete conservative parity
options.body: Retain the feature scope and fix the bounded cache, outcome, tool-classification, patch, and write-preview cases before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Render only authoritative persisted diffs for recognized edit tools, defer argument-derived previews until their outcomes and cache representation are available.

recommendation.title: Complete conservative parity
recommendation.body: Retain the feature scope and fix the bounded cache, outcome, tool-classification, patch, and write-preview cases before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work places this person closest to the intended shared Apple chat behavior and its web-parity boundary.
